_doc: CTSF residual-set-diff gate baseline — EUROPEAN UNION (#183/#204/#221). Frozen typed-residual set of the REAL EU corpus, keyed {sid: {family: count}} with only non-zero families retained. TWO lanes: (1) the #221 ORACLE-TOUCH lane (corpus_oracle_bases, sid = base CELEX) — per stored PUBLISHED sector-0 consolidation the multi-amender PIT closure is replayed offline and diffed per-article against the consolidation; Finland's neutral touch-relation calculus types every divergence (oracle_editorial_pathology / temporal_mismatch for commensurability-limited gap windows), closure acquisition/lowering gaps are explicit typed cnf_unsupported/temporal_mismatch rows, and apply RAISEs / conservation violations stay billable; (2) the #204 conserved-apply FALLBACK lane (corpus_chains, sid = amender->base) for the one base with ZERO published consolidations (32017R1576). The consolidation is an EDITORIAL witness (no legal value) — divergences are typed, never repaired toward. The gate FAILs iff a NEW replay_bug/unknown residual appears vs this set; WARNs on a typed non-billable move. This corpus is 0-BILLABLE at freeze: the flip itself convicted two genuine replay bugs (omnibus cross-target misapplication + quoted-payload boundary defects on 32022R2309@20230216) which were fixed at root in fmx4_amendment_grammar before freezing. #9 EU-AMENDER-ACQUISITION wave: the 3 truly-missing amenders + 34 wrong-manifestation-item stores (a DOC envelope / ANNEX member / TIFF stored in lieu of the ACT body) were durably re-acquired ACT-rooted via eu_acquire.resolve_act_body's sibling-DOC_N walk (scripts/acquire_eu_amenders.py); every newly-applied instruction was adjudicated — several windows moved TOWARD the oracle (temporal_mismatch dropped) and the rest surfaced as VISIBLE typed cnf_unsupported lowering gaps — keeping the corpus 0-BILLABLE (0 new replay_bug/unknown). 2026-07-08 EU payload-boundary repair: the 32015R0340 Article 9 witness exposed that QUOT.S payload collection stopped at an inner quote around the defined term, dropping the operative definition tail for 32012R0923 Article 2 point 104. Matching the outer QUOT.START/QUOT.END pair fixed the deterministic payload loss (unknown returns to 0; 32012R0923 cnf_unsupported 23→10 and temporal_mismatch 36→35; corpus residual total 1043→1021) and persisted the non-gating typed_skip_bucket_counts census. 2026-07-08 EU ALINEA subparagraph-coordinate repair: the 32013R1022 → 32010R1093 witness exposed that PARAG>ALINEA encoded legal subparagraphs as P/LIST/P/P blocks, so targets like article:1/paragraph:5/subparagraph:2 missed. The grafter now materializes those P/LIST/P groups as subparagraph coordinates when the post-list P is a new uppercase/digit-starting subparagraph, while lowercase post-list continuations remain flat (protecting 32022R2309 Articles 6/9). This closes 34 target_kind_label_absent skips (32010R1093 cnf_unsupported 117→83; corpus residual total 1021→987) with billable residuals still 0. 2026-07-08 EU insert parent-prefix repair: the 32013R1022 → 32010R1093 witnesses 32013R1022-1.11 and -1.24 showed that INSERT parent paths (article:8 and article:29/paragraph:2) existed under unnamed DIVISION wrappers, but exact body-root resolution rejected them as parent_unresolved/parent_scope_unresolved. INSERT now binds a unique requested parent suffix under its declared first scope, leaving unscoped lookalike hijacks rejected. This closes 62 more 32010R1093 cnf_unsupported skips and moves 16 temporal mismatch rows toward the oracle (corpus residual total 987→905), billable residuals still 0. 2026-07-08 EU nested alpha point repair: the 32016R1185 → 32012R0923 witness showed that 'points (a), (b) and (c) of point 90' lowered as top-level Article 2 points a/b/c, while the base FMX4 encoded those alpha children under numeric point 90. The grafter now materializes explicitly encoded nested alpha LIST children under their numeric point, and the NP grammar carries the 'of point 90' parent context into the lowered target. This closes the remaining three 32012R0923 target_kind_label_absent skips (cnf_unsupported 10→7; corpus residual total 905→902), billable residuals still 0. 2026-07-08 EU point-of-article repeal repair: the 32011R0057 → 32009R0754 witness said 'Point (h) of Article 1 is deleted', but the broad whole-article repeal recognizer read the embedded Article 1 citation as the target and deleted the host article. The grammar now recognizes this source shape as a point repeal before whole-article repeal, preserving Article 1 for 32012R1040 point j/k/l inserts and 32013R1182 point b/j repeals. This closes five 32009R0754 typed skips (cnf_unsupported 7→2; corpus residual total 902→897), billable residuals still 0. 2026-07-08 EU paragraph-of-article replacement repair: the 32011R1295 → 32009R1284 witness said 'Paragraph (1) of Article 4 is replaced', but the broad whole-article recognizer read the embedded Article 4 citation as the target and flattened the host article. The grammar now recognizes this source shape as a paragraph replacement before whole-article replacement, preserving Article 4 for 32013R0049 point g/h inserts. This closes two 32009R1284 typed skips (cnf_unsupported 21→19; corpus residual total 897→895), billable residuals still 0. 2026-07-08 EU sole-annex target guard: the 32013R0517 → 32009R1284 witness said 'The following Regulations are amended as set out in the Annex', which does not name a base-annex coordinate. The grammar now emits a typed annex_extraction_gap instead of minting an executable bare @supplements annex: target. This removes the empty_target_label typed skip (32009R1284 cnf_unsupported 19→18; corpus residual total 895→894), billable residuals still 0. 2026-07-08 EU annex-context insert root repair: the 32024R1143 → 32019R0787 witnesses insert points into Annex I, and lowering now roots annex-context NP insert targets in @supplements while replay resolves such inserts against the supplements tree when present. The frozen 32019R0787 bytes still lack Annex I, so the three skips remain non-billable cnf_unsupported but move from parent_unresolved to annex_lane_target_absent; corpus residual total remains 894, billable residuals still 0. Regenerate with `uv run python -m lawvm.core.ctsf_gate --update-eu-baseline` (needs the EU Cellar Farchive) after a legitimate, reviewed corpus/projection change — a preregistered predict-then-compare event, never a silent baseline move.
